_about: StoryBook AI configuration file. Copy this file, rename it to storybook_config.json (or storybook_config_sdxl.json for SDXL models), fill in your values, and remove all '_note' and '_about' keys before use.

forge._note: Settings for the Stable Diffusion Forge WebUI backend.
forge.path: REQUIRED — Absolute path to your Forge WebUI installation folder. Example: C:\Users\YourName\stable-diffusion-webui-forge
forge._port_note: Port Forge's API listens on. 7860 is the default; only change if you've configured Forge differently.
forge._auto_start_note: If true, StoryBook AI will launch Forge automatically on startup. Set to false if you start Forge yourself.
forge._startup_timeout_note: Seconds to wait for Forge to finish loading before giving up. Increase this on slower machines.
forge._api_enabled_note: Must be true. StoryBook AI communicates with Forge through its REST API.
forge._nowebui_note: If true, Forge starts without opening a browser window. Recommended.

generation._note: Image generation parameters sent to Forge for each slide. These depend heavily on the model (checkpoint) you have loaded.
generation._width_note: Output image width in pixels. Use 512 for SD 1.5 / anime models. Use 1024 for SDXL models.
generation._height_note: Output image height in pixels. Match width above.
generation._steps_note: Number of diffusion steps. 20-28 is typical. More steps = slower but sometimes more refined. See tensor recommendations.
generation._cfg_scale_note: Classifier-free guidance scale. Controls how closely the image follows the prompt. 5.0-7.5 is typical. Lower = more creative, higher = more literal.
generation._sampler_note: Sampling algorithm. Recommended for SD 1.5/anime: 'DPM++ 2M Karras'. Recommended for SDXL: 'DPM++ 2M SDE Karras'. Euler is also acceptable.
generation._seed_note: Random seed. -1 means a new random seed each generation. Set a fixed integer to reproduce the same image.
generation.quality_prefix: masterpiece, best quality, amazing quality, very aesthetic, absurdres, newest
generation._quality_prefix_note: Quality booster tags appended AFTER your scene description in the prompt. For SD 1.5/anime models use Danbooru-style tags like the default. For SDXL use natural phrases like 'high quality, highly detailed, sharp focus'. These are skipped automatically on violation slides.
generation.negative_prompt: lowres, (worst quality, bad quality:1.2), bad anatomy, sketch, jpeg artifacts, signature, watermark, old, oldest, censored, bar_censor, simple background, conjoined
generation._negative_prompt_note: Fallback negative prompt used if Claude does not supply one. Describe what you do NOT want in the image. Syntax varies by model — SD 1.5 supports weighted tags like (tag:1.2); SDXL prefers plain phrases.

claude._note: Controls how Claude generates image prompts. These must match the model type loaded in Forge.
claude._prompt_style_note: How Claude phrases the image prompt. 'tags' = short comma-separated Danbooru-style keywords (best for SD 1.5 / anime models). 'natural' = descriptive English phrases (best for SDXL). Switching model types requires changing this.
claude._max_prompt_chars_note: Maximum characters Claude's prompt is allowed to reach before truncation. SD 1.5 CLIP encoder fits roughly 380 characters (~77 tokens). SDXL dual encoder fits roughly 750 characters. Set this to match your model.
claude.base_negative: lowres, (worst quality, bad quality:1.2), bad anatomy, sketch, jpeg artifacts, signature, watermark, old, oldest, censored, bar_censor, simple background, conjoined
claude._base_negative_note: The negative prompt Claude is instructed to output by default. Should match the generation.negative_prompt above. Claude may extend this per-slide based on content.
